# Brief S3 + S6 (2026-09-22): SEO/AEO/GEO and pages completeness

Conductor amendments to "Batch S3" and "Batch S6" in
`docs/build/PLAN-ship-2026-09-21.md` §2. Read that plan's batch paragraph for
your batch (files, builds-on, data, steps, accept criteria) and then these
amendments, which win where they differ.

## Rules for both builders

1. **Locales.** A global Arabic voice sweep is rewriting every existing value under
   `locales/` right now. Never edit an existing value. New keys go in
   `locales/partials/seo.{ar,en}.json` (S3) or `locales/partials/s6.{ar,en}.json`
   (S6): flat `ox.*` keys only, Arabic first, English a true translation, AND
   identically into `locales/ar.json` + `locales/en.json`. Modern Standard Arabic,
   no diacritics, no dialect, no em-dash, no AI-tell constructions
   (`docs/brand/voice-ksa.md` §3; `pnpm check:copy` enforces). Snippet contract (KOS SEO-ENG-010, binding): one title and one meta
   description per indexable page, never duplicated across pages. Arabic titles
   45-55 characters (hard ceiling 60), Arabic descriptions 130-150 (hard ceiling
   160; the proposition in the first 120). English titles 50-60, descriptions
   140-160. Primary entity + qualifying term in the first 50 characters; brand
   last after a pipe (" | اوبتيمال اكس" / " | OptimalX"); where a geo term
   will not fit, brand yields first. Both locale twins are measured
   independently, in the build, against the shipped artifact: a test that
   reports "title 81/60"-style breaches, never a bare verdict.
2. **Claims.** `docs/build/research/FINAL-claims-source.md` is the law; `node
   scripts/check-claims.mjs` must stay at 0. No ratings/review counts
   (`AggregateRating` only when `rating.count > 0`), no invented numbers, no
   delivery promises, no "100%", no professional titles, no outcome promises, one
   branch only (Al-Khalidiyah, Medina).
3. **Taxonomy is S1's** and has landed: `app/content/taxonomy.ts` exports
   `TAXONOMY`, `nodeBySlug`, `childrenOf`, `MENU`; each node carries `nameKey`,
   `h1Key`, `titleKey`, `descriptionKey`, `introKey`, `faq[]`; names live in
   `locales/partials/tax.{ar,en}.json`. Read only; request changes through your
   progress file.
4. **Do not touch** files owned by other batches: S1 (`app/components/listing/**`
   except `listing/head.ts` for S3, `app/content/**`, `app/routes/categories.tsx`),
   S2 (`app/components/home/**`, `app/assets/ox-sprite.svg`, `app/components/common/Icon.tsx`,
   `app/components/product/PdpIcon.tsx`, `app/styles/06-ox/_b2-home.scss`),
   the perf batch (`app/components/layout/BottomTabBar.tsx`, `_b1-layout.scss`).
   S3 owns head builders and route head extensions; S6 owns page/commerce
   components and the non-head parts of routes. If both need one route file, S3
   edits only the `head` export and S6 only the component.
5. No Arabic/English literal in `app/` (`pnpm check:strings`); logical CSS
   properties only (`pnpm check:rtl`); `pnpm check:motion` green.
6. Never git add/commit/push. Never start a server: the offline preview runs on
   3210 and every direct URL needs `?storeId=1888890798`
   (`curl -s "http://localhost:3210/<path>?storeId=1888890798"`). Never request
   api.salla.dev.
7. Verify before reporting: `pnpm typecheck`; the vitest folders your batch names;
   `pnpm check:all`; the curls your accept criteria name. Paste tails. Write
   `docs/build/progress/S3.md` or `S6.md` (steps, files, findings, requests to
   other batches, verification tails) and return the same content raw.

## S3 amendments

KOS excerpts the builder must follow (it has no KOS access):
- SEO-ENG-006 Structured Data: JSON-LD only; structured data describes reality,
  never invents; every property matches visible content; hierarchy
  Organization → WebSite → WebPage → primary entity → related entities →
  Offers; one `@graph` per page with stable `@id`s; validate in the build.
- SEO-AI-003 GEO: optimize for reasoning, not ranking; answer-first blocks
  (the first sentence of an intro answers the head query); evidence stays
  attached to claims (numbers only where the label/fixture carries them);
  entities named consistently across pages (same brand and ingredient
  spellings as `docs/build/research/keywords-ar.md` §7).
- SEO-ENG-008 Arabic: MSA, no combining marks, no dialect; Arabic and English
  twins are true translations; canonical/hreflang per locale.

- The engine is `@salla.sa/twilight-theme-engine` ^1.0.53 (check
  `node_modules/@salla.sa/twilight-theme-engine/package.json`); route files
  `app/routes/account.pending_orders.tsx` and `app/routes/logout.tsx` are
  engine-generated (`// @auto-generated`), leave them.
- Home head: title/description keys `ox.seo.home.title` / `ox.seo.home.description`
  in `seo.*`, built from `docs/build/research/keywords-ar.md` H01.
- Listing head: title = `t(node.titleKey)`, description = `t(node.descriptionKey)`
  from the taxonomy node; `/categories` (S1's new route) gets a CollectionPage
  head with its own `seo.*` title/description and `noindex` = false.
- Sitemap and robots are platform-served: ship neither.
- Add a build-time test over every head-bearing page (home, the 25 taxonomy
  nodes, /categories, services, branch, about, contact, policies, blog index)
  that measures the shipped title and description in both locales against the
  SEO-ENG-010 contract (Arabic title 45-55 target / 60 ceiling, Arabic
  description 130-150 target / 160 ceiling; English 50-60 and 140-160) and
  reports each breach as "key: title 81/60".
- English: the theme must render at `/en/...` with English heads (`stripLocale`
  in `seo/head.ts` already handles canonicals): add one test per head builder
  with `locale: 'en'`.

## S6 amendments

- `app/routes/kitchen-sink.tsx` is 404 in production builds and tree-shaken
  (step 1 of the plan). Verify with `grep -l KitchenSink dist/` after
  `pnpm build` (you may run `pnpm build`; do not run `pnpm preview`).
- SSR sweep (step 2) covers every route in `app/routes.ts` including S1's
  `/categories`; paste the script output. Known: the header search placeholder
  renders the raw key `blocks.header.search_placeholder` from the engine
  translator: fix by passing the theme string explicitly where the header is
  ours (`app/components/layout/Header/**` is owned by another batch: file a
  request with the exact line instead of editing it).
- Empty states (step 3): 0 brands, 0 posts, signed-out account, wishlist,
  orders, wallet, notifications, loyalty, testimonials, offers, most-sales,
  search zero: each renders `EmptyState` with one h1 and one route out.
- Delete `CustomCartPage.tsx` / `CustomBrands.tsx` only if `grep -rn` finds no
  importer.
- English: the account, cart, thank-you, policy and 404 pages must read
  correctly at `/en/...` (curl each with the locale prefix; no raw keys, no
  Arabic leaking into the English render).
